data.body:
Completion evidence (merged commit 24917e843b, Gerrit change 1547).

[operator-attested] Recovered comment-line count (measured by diff): this shard's scope was in GOOD health, so the yield was corrections + rationale-homing, NOT bulk removal. Code files (review_bot/app.py, config.py, voter.py): 10 comment lines removed / 14 added — a small NET ADD, because three multi-line inline rationale blocks were relocated into ADRs 0067/0068/0069 and replaced with one-line ADR citations (net near-zero by design). git show --stat: 8 files, 236 insertions(+), 12 deletions(-) (the insertions are the three new ADR files + the tools.md do_not_move ledger + docs/env-vars.md regen). Four verified-stale comments were CORRECTED in place; no unit was force-deleted (conservative, per the healthy-scope disposition).

[operator-attested] No behaviour change — full test suite + lint + typecheck pass unchanged. Authoritative proof: Gerrit change 1547 earned Verified+1 — CI ran the FULL pytest suite across all four matrix jobs (ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos 3.13), all green (run 31264424766). Locally: held-out validation over the review_bot/attest/metrics/opcert/audit/grounding subsystems = 1088 passed, 24 skipped; make lint green (ruff + format + complexity baseline + config-read gate + zizmor + actionlint); make typecheck green (mypy, no issues in 440 files). This change is comment/docstring/docs text only — no runtime logic touched (_mcp_models.py, _mcp_llm.py, _config_schema.py all left out of the diff).

ADRs 0067 (bounded two-phase shutdown), 0068 (in-flight counter deliberate over-count), 0069 (retryable coverage-gap bounded deferral) each document a real, in-force invariant confirmed present in the code and are cited from the seam they explain.
